title: Mistake: onClick={save()}
why_it_matters: The function runs during render, not on click.
explanation: Parentheses call a function immediately. onClick needs the function itself, not its result. Pass the name, or wrap a call in an arrow function when you need to pass arguments.
code:
<button onClick={save()}>Save</button>      {/* runs on render */}
<button onClick={save}>Save</button>        {/* runs on click */}
<button onClick={() => remove(id)}>Delete</button>
try_it: Search your code for onClick={ followed by a function name with parentheses.
